description: A complete one-sentence description of the route, its story and the kind of places players will discover.
short_description: A lively, compact description written for the adventure card.
author: Your name
transport_note: A town-centre walking route using public pavements and paths. Add useful accessibility, terrain, parking or public-transport information here.

before_you_go.terrain: Describe the real surfaces players will use, such as pavements, cobbles, grass or riverside paths.
before_you_go.hills: Say whether the route is level, gently sloped or includes a notable climb or descent.
before_you_go.steps: Say whether steps are required and give a truthful alternative where one exists.
before_you_go.accessibility: Give a cautious, practical summary without promising that temporary conditions will be accessible.
before_you_go.toilets: Explain where players can check for public facilities without relying on the mystery final venue.
before_you_go.footwear: Recommend suitable footwear for the actual terrain.
before_you_go.dogs: Explain outdoor suitability and remind players to check the final venue’s current dog policy.
before_you_go.pushchairs: Explain whether gradients, cobbles, narrow paths or steps may make the route difficult.

stops.Cryptic_Clue: Write a playful clue that identifies the landmark without simply naming it.
stops.Hint_1: Give a useful direction or describe the area where the player should look.
stops.Hint_2: Give a clearer visual description that should help a stuck player find the exact landmark.
stops.Unlock_Fact: Reveal the landmark and tell a specific, interesting and accurately checked story about it.

stops.Cryptic_Clue: End with a clue leading to a real pub, restaurant or café where players can finish their day.
stops.Hint_1: Guide players towards the final venue without giving its name away immediately.
stops.Hint_2: Describe the venue, its sign or its location clearly enough to finish the route.
stops.Unlock_Fact: Begin with ‘Route complete!’ and share a checked fact about the venue or building, then invite players to finish with food or a drink if it is open.
